subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu card actions use when `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, or `name` are present alongside existing command/text values?
rationale: The owner-local fix is small, but the exact JSON-versus-command behavior becomes a Feishu channel contract and can change existing command-style card interactions.

options.title: Refresh compatibility-preserving passthrough
options.body: Rework this PR around current `monitor.account.ts`/`card-interaction.ts`, preserving `value.command` dispatch while carrying form/select data in a documented structured payload.

options.title: Ship a narrower form-only contract
options.body: Limit the first fix to `form_value` or a single supported callback shape if maintainers want less compatibility surface before selector/input behavior is designed.

options.title: Decline generic passthrough for now
options.body: Keep Feishu card actions command-only until a broader interactive-card payload design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Refresh compatibility-preserving passthrough
recommendation.body: Rework this PR around current `monitor.account.ts`/`card-interaction.ts`, preserving `value.command` dispatch while carrying form/select data in a documented structured payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact for the affected channel contract.
